mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing borrowing costs and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 3.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the tight labor market fuels wage inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between labor market and wage inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter signals reduced supply chain pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns after INDPRO declines are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high and rising GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, leading to consistently positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between GDP and equity markets
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI (CPIAUCSL) growth are both above their respective 2-year averages, the combination of tight monetary policy and high inflation leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical impact of monetary policy on inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 1% in 2 months signals a rapidly deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns after UNRATE spikes are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% in a quarter and housing starts (HOUST) are above 1100K, the combined demand boost from consumer spending and housing leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > 5% in a quarter and HOUST > 1100K
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between retail sales, housing, and equity markets
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
